# `nlink-lab shell`

<!-- generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit by hand -->

```text
Open an interactive shell in a lab node

Usage: nlink-lab shell [OPTIONS] <LAB> <NODE>

Arguments:
  <LAB>
          Lab name

  <NODE>
          Node name

Options:
      --shell <SHELL>
          Shell to use (default: /bin/sh)
          
          [default: /bin/sh]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
